column1: # Runtime-only entries (loaded after neoforge-1.21.1.tsv, they win): what the source converter handles by hand in
# the main classes of the ports (event buses, mod bootstrap, lifecycle events), for original 1.21.1 jars.
# GUI: 1.21 listener interfaces, widgets and NeoForge widgets (Translator classes; Screen is a facade, see -supers.tsv)
# FML loader seam: what a mod asks the loader (its container, the mod list, paths, lifecycle) is the Translator's;
# the rest of the FML loader jar (events, interfaces) is carried with the 1.21.1 API
# carried as they are (the same name): the real 1.21.1 classes, complete; the Translator facades of the source
# ports have only a part of them
# entity data: 1.12.2 DataParameter / DataSerializer under the 1.21 names
# DataFixerUpper 8 DataResult.Error: the DataFixerUpper 4 PartialResult (message(), partialResult())
# NeoForge registries: a new registry is the registry of its key; the scan data of the mods
# the base of BlockState: what 1.21 code types as BlockStateBase is the same IBlockState
# Minecraft.getWindow(): the sizes of the 1.12.2 display; FormattedText / FormattedCharSequence: text components
# 1.21 interfaces mods implement, mapped to unrelated 1.12.2 classes (Equipable -> ItemArmor, UnbakedModel ->
# ModelBlock): an implementer can't be cast to that class, so the interface is carried as it is
# the texture of a model (atlas + texture), not a block material
# render seams of the Translator (client): a pose is the PoseStack (GL matrix), the immediate buffer source, the
# the 1.21 text field: a widget of the screen (constructor, responder, input events) on GuiTextField
# the scheduled ticks of a level: the 1.12.2 world's pending block updates (level.getBlockTicks())
# a sprite's contents (size, name) are the 1.12.2 sprite itself
# the 1.21 vertex path: Tesselator.begin gives the buffer, its vertices go through a VertexConsumer, the built mesh is drawn
# saved data of the mods: built without a name, saved by save(tag, registries), read by their factory
# a tool's attribute modifiers (createAttributes), armor types
# 1.21 block types whose facade isn't the 1.12.2 class (leaves without decay, saplings on BlockBush, Forge fluid blocks): the type itself
# the resources of the game: the 1.12.2 client resource manager's (listed from the 1.21.1 mod jars)
# game rules by key, damage sources of a level, text colors, effect categories, loot context parameters
# 1.21 vanilla block types with no 1.12.2 class of the same build: facades on the Translator's Block (their 1.21 state properties)
# world saves (server.storageSource, map mods): the 1.12.2 save folder
# 1.21 RenderHandEvent is fired per hand: the 1.12.2 RenderSpecificHandEvent (hand, item, swing, equip progress)
# 1.21 widget tooltips (Tooltip.create, setTooltip, Button.Builder.tooltip): drawn after the screen
# images and dynamic textures (map mods, generated icons): the pixels on the Java heap (1.21 keeps them in native
# memory and decodes with LWJGL 3 STB, which 1.12.2 lacks), PNG files through ImageIO, the 1.12.2 dynamic texture
# the client resource manager as 1.21 ReloadableResourceManager (a cast map mods make to add a reload listener)
# 1.21 Style is immutable: its with* methods give a new style (StyleStatics, MiscBridges), not the 1.12.2 setters
# 1.21 StringRepresentable.fromEnum returns its EnumCodec (byName): the Translator method with that result
# 1.21 isComplex (an item with its own data packet, a map) stays its own method: 1.12.2's isMap means an
# ItemMapBase, which the player's tick casts to (calls on a 1.12.2 item go to ItemBridges.isComplex)
# the NeoForge server lifecycle events, posted from the FML ones (Translator)
# the /tick state: 1.12.2 always ticks at 20 a second (Create asks it for the speed of its machines)
# 1.21's data fixers: the data of a mod on 1.12.2 is its own version already (a fixer that changes nothing)
# entity capabilities on 1.12.2 Forge capabilities (Curios, Accessories)
# 1.21 RegistryOps (a format with the registries), the left arm of humanoid models
# 1.21 entity models: the Translator's model parts (a 1.12.2 ModelRenderer with 1.21's named children and cubes),
# baked from the mods' layer definitions (the 1.21 classes as they are)
# 1.21 ChunkMap: the players a chunk is sent to (1.12.2 PlayerChunkMap)
# 1.21 PotionContents (a value, not 1.12.2's static PotionUtils): the potion tags of a stack
# 1.21 entity renderers and models: the Translator's classes (1.21 names kept), drawn on 1.12.2's Render
# 1.21 game rule values over 1.12.2's string rules
# 1.21 addAdditionalSaveData is 1.12.2 writeEntityToNBT (the read side has its row in the name table): mobs of
# mods that extend LivingEntity / AbstractArrow saved none of their own data
# 1.21 level data (time, weather, spawn, rules) is the 1.12.2 WorldInfo: JourneyMap's map task read level.getLevelData().getDayTime()
# X: calls redirected although 1.12.2 has the member (its meaning differs): the 1.21 dye names (silver is light_gray)
# NeoForge ComputeFovModifierEvent is Forge 1.12.2 FOVUpdateEvent (bows' zoom: Twilight Forest, every mod bow)
